FN-F4LB5C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 66
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/22/2023
Senate Bill 66 as introduced would impose a 5% tax on the gross proceeds of the retail sale of
any products containing psychoactive cannabinoids. This would increase sales tax receipts to the
Education Trust Fund, and to the cities and counties by an undetermined amount, dependent
upon the amount of gross proceeds from the sale of psychoactive cannabinoids purchased at
retail.
Further, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed.

FN-F4LB5C-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 66
Committee: Health Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 66 as passed the Senate would impose an 8% tax on the gross proceeds of the retail
sale of any products containing psychoactive cannabinoids. This would increase sales tax
receipts presumably to the State General Fund by an undetermined amount, dependent upon the
amount of gross proceeds from the sale of psychoactive cannabinoids purchased at retail.
Further, this bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds
from fines which could range between $50 to $200 per violation; increase receipts to the State
General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds and other funds to which court
costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district
attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons
charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
